name: Docmode Health Technologies Ltd.
summary: Docmode Health Technologies Ltd. is a specialized health-tech company that provides online and offline learning and training solutions for medical professionals. The company operates as a platform for Continuing Medical Education and Continuing Professional Development, serving doctors, nurses, allied healthcare professionals, and medical students globally. Its offerings include DocMode.org (also known as DocMode LERN), a comprehensive portal with over 500 courses, certification programs, and interactive learning tools across various medical specialties. Additionally, it provides specialized platforms such as i-Move for orthopedics and physical therapy education, G-LSMS for managing learner progress and compliance for large medical organizations, and the Gapsule platform, which bridges knowledge gaps between the pharmaceutical industry, medical practitioners, and healthcare providers. Docmode also supports clinical and market research through its DocMode SURE platform, which facilitates surveys and studies. The company offers the iNutrimon clinical application for record-keeping and enhancing healthcare professional-patient relationships, and its DocMode KNOW segment provides knowledge marketing and CRM solutions to medico-marketing organizations. Operating on both B2B and B2C models, Docmode derives revenue from educational services, certification programs, and advertising and sponsorships from pharmaceutical and medical device companies, while also providing specialized Learning Management System solutions to healthcare organizations.
